reviewer: Codex AI linguistic and visual review
scope: Six current contact sheets covering all 48 marketing panels, plus full-resolution first-page PDF preview screenshots in all six locales. These are API 36 emulator captures, not physical Fire captures.
limitations: Codex AI linguistic and visual review only; not human native-speaker review or qualified safety, legal or Amazon approval.
Contact sheets sample all 48 marketing panels; full-resolution native inspection in this final pass is limited to the six listed first-page PDF screenshots.
No exported PDF files, second report pages, interactive zoom or physical Fire execution reviewed in this final pass.
Approval is pinned to current SHA256 values and limited to the listed visual assets; later asset changes require corresponding review.
sampledObservations: All six locales have localized native UI, synthetic fixture text and marketing headlines; no missing-script glyphs observed.
Full native PDF first-page previews render Arabic joining, Hindi marks and conjuncts, Japanese, Korean and both Chinese scripts legibly without observed clipping or text overlap.
Arabic navigation and controls follow RTL, while explicit Arabic page-current-of-total wording resolves the earlier fraction ambiguity.
Arabic singular inventory unit قطعة is used as a fixed structured unit label; user-entered units are not inferred or altered by this review.
Current screenshot status bars have light icons against dark backgrounds and a visible light navigation gesture indicator.
Marketing headlines fit, navigation branding is complete and hero spacing is readable; partially visible lower cards are normal vertical scrolling.
No remaining linguistic or visual blocker identified in this scoped sample.
reviewStage: Final current-source API 36 emulator captures from CI run 41561192222; copied to assets approximately 01:57 UTC and contact sheets regenerated approximately 01:58 UTC on 3 November 2026.

resolvedFindings.evidence: Full navigation branding is visible within framed bounds in all six current contact sheets.
Arabic overview now shows 1 kit, 6 supplies and 2 approaching dates in the current contact sheet.
Two-line hero headings have readable separated baselines in all six current overview panels.
Full native current Arabic report preview reads الصفحة 1 من 2, making current page and total unambiguous. Previous disabled and Next enabled are consistent.
